title: GLM can finish a response with native search starts lacking result receipts
wanted_capability: Distinguish completed provider-native search results from proposals whose execution status remains unknown; do not infer executions from starts or declare native completion consistency passed without matching receipts.
fallback_used: Retain raw native blocks and explicitly mark the probe inconclusive; paired result counts include provider errors and are not successful-execution counts.
evidence: 2026-09-07 broad flagship live suite request007: native max_uses5, ten distinct starts, five matching results, five unmatched IDs, successful terminal response
notes: Discovered during duplicate-execution containment validation. All ten queries concern requested Python documentation, so this is not evidence of unrelated spurious searching. Five receipts may reflect the configured native budget, but there is no receipt proving whether the remaining starts were skipped or executed. Do not claim max_uses was ignored from starts alone. Runner6f87a8a2 now removes false-green reporting by recording unmatched IDs. Provider completion behavior remains unresolved.
resolution_note: obsolete: 6f87a8a2 makes scripts/probe-glm-native-search.py report native starts, matched results and unmatched start ids separately and treat missing receipts as inconclusive; failed-turn observations mark unmatched server_tool_use blocks native_result_missing with execution_status unknown (crates/bro-harness/src/transport/anthropic.rs), and nothing in the harness counts starts as executions. The residual question of how the provider completes unmatched starts is provider behavior, not a substrate gap.
